notes: Pump-intake safety calibration: SENSOR_DISTANCE_PUMP_MM (Gist water_level.sensor_distance_pump_mm) sets the dry-run cutoff as a measured sensor distance instead of a percentage; takes precedence over WATER_PUMP_CUTOFF_PCT when >0. Pump safety checks now read the cutoff at runtime (fixes Gist override not reaching main.py). Grafana shows a 'Pump cutoff (safety)' reference line.
